pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics and deep melancholic ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced in first 10 seconds)

지친 하루 끝, 무너진 어둠에
말 없이 별빛처럼 스며와
아직도 가슴 깊이 울린다

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with delicate gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm evoking collapse)

기억에 여전히 빛나는데
그 어디에도 닿지 못한 채
멈춰진 시간의 틈 속에서

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising with pain, ajaeng glissando, percussion layering gradually, taepyeongso soft desperate tease)

지워내면 더 또렷해지는
네 목소리, 네 숨소리

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising intensely, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation building heavy tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with emotional soaring melody full of despair, gayageum rhythm cutting through)

나는 끝없이 무너져버려
너 없는 세상은 색을 잃어
아직 그 자리에 I’m breaking down
falling apart tonight

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal with raw emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring sorrow and pain)

나는 끝없이 무너져버려
너 없는 세상은 색을 잃어
아무리 애써도 지워지지 않아
난 다시 살아가

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding heavy emptiness)

바람 한 줄기도 네 향기가 겹쳐와
네 미소가 떠올라 가슴이 허물어지고
이미 모든 것이 무너졌어

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low painful stabs, taepyeongso short intense motifs)

Yo, everything’s crumbling, shadows closing in
Your voice still echoes deep under my skin
Ajaeng screams the pain I can’t erase
Taepyeongso cries out in this empty space
Bass drop heavy like the weight on my chest
Even in dreams I’m searching for your breath

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional collapse tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring desperate melody, full percussion explosion, female emotional adlib)

나는 끝없이 무너져버려
너 없는 세상은 색을 잃어
아직 그 자리에 I’m breaking down
falling apart tonight

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

나는 끝없이 무너져버려
너 없는 세상은 색을 잃어
아무리 애써도 지워지지 않아
난 다시 살아가
다시 돌아올 수 없다면
꿈에라도 내 손을 잡아줘
그 온기라도 숨 쉴 수 있어
난 다시 살아가

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and deep broken ajaeng drone, whispered male "I’m still falling... take me with you")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
